name: @fleetfrog/agent-rs
description: The FleetFrog agent as a native Rust binary. It speaks the same protocol as apps/agent-ts and shares its files on the machine.

scripts.build: cargo build --release --locked && mkdir -p dist && cp target/release/fleetfrog dist/fleetfrog.tmp && mv -f dist/fleetfrog.tmp dist/fleetfrog
